goal: Make the vast lifecycle VERBOSE in the room and PLANNED instead of guessed. Three deliverables: (1) watch/blade_room_bridge.py — a tiny run-once bridge that tails state/vast/blade_buyer.log + state/vast/boot_watch.log and posts new lifecycle lines into watch/room.jsonl as seat='blade_buyer' thread='blades' (contract-signed / gate-passed / proxy-dark / READY / reap events); (2) state/vast/launch_plan.schema.json + a generator mag/blade_plan.py: `python -m mag.blade_plan <template-name> <work-description>` writes state/vast/launch_plans/<ts>_<template>.json with template, dph (from blade_templates.json), EXPECTED boot minutes (median pull+ready from boot_watch.log history), ttl_h from covenant, est_cost = dph*ttl; (3) tests/test_blade_plan.py. The rule it encodes: NO launch without a plan file, and every phase speaks in the room.
invariants: boot-time expectations come ONLY from boot_watch.log history — no guessed numbers; if history <3 boots for a template, expected_boot_min = null with note 'no history yet'
bridge is run-once (like codex_room.py) — no daemon; the buyer/cadence invokes it per pass
covenant caps read-only; buyer_enabled stays false
Edit tool for source; no docker; no instances
acceptance_commands: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m mag.blade_plan qwen3-8b-ollama 'test drain batch' && ls state/vast/launch_plans/ | head -2
resume_command: codex exec --skip-git-repo-check -C <repo> 'read jobs/vast-verbosity/seat_contract.json + latest trail_core, do next_action, run acceptance_commands, write trail_core_N'
